scenarios.reason: Final verification failed: "the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free and the total is €81.90"
scenarios.diagnosis: After the requested items were added and the promo code was entered and applied, the checkout kept the full €91.00 total instead of showing the €9.10 discount and €81.90 total.
